category_title: Struggling and reluctant middle school learners in intervention language arts
scenario_title: Responding to daily questions on class blog
minimal_context: The student is using a computer during a rotation to respond to a daily question about the novel 'Stargirl' on the class blog.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please log into the computers and respond to today's question about the characters' actions in 'Stargirl' on the class blog.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I just wrote that I agree with Maria. She did a good thing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you write a little more about that?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why? I gave a specific answer to the specific question. Is this going to be on the standardized test?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to add another sentence to your blog post.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Whispers to a peer and pushes the keyboard away) I'm refusing to work on this anymore. I already wrote my two sentences and I don't care about developing my writing skills if it's not for a test score.
